def slide_reach(grid,n,start):
 R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0]); q=deque([start]); seen={start}; adj={}
 while q:
  r,c=q.popleft(); adj[(r,c)]=[]
  for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
   rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
   if rr<0 or cc<0 or rr+n>R or cc+n>C or (rr,cc) in seen:continue
   strip=[]
   if dr==1: strip=[(r+n,c+j) for j in range(n)]
   if dr==-1: strip=[(r-1,c+j) for j in range(n)]
   if dc==1: strip=[(r+i,c+n) for i in range(n)]
   if dc==-1: strip=[(r+i,c-1) for i in range(n)]
   if all(grid[x][y]==1 for x,y in strip):
    adj[(r,c)].append((rr,cc));seen.add((rr,cc));q.append((rr,cc))
  
 return seen,adj
